B1_diagnostic.branch_fail: STOP_AFTER_B1; no B2-B7; write B1_DECISION and B_DECISION as diagnostic stop, no selected candidate
B1_diagnostic.deduplication: one receipt per cluster_id and condition; never count arm replicas as independent samples
B1_diagnostic.objective: maximize minimum per-effect TPR with receipt-level FPR <= cap
B1_diagnostic.threshold_candidates: unique observed per-effect scores plus all-reject endpoint; inclusive score >= threshold
B1_diagnostic.tie_break: maximize min TPR, then minimize receipt FPR, then maximize sum per-effect TPR, then lexicographically highest threshold vector by sorted effect key

B3: qualification only; report each effect confusion counts and Wilson intervals, receipt false upgrades; fail on qualification means estimation insufficient, pass qualification then fail formal means transfer failure

B4.curve: all observed receipt thresholds plus endpoints
B4.eligibility: exclude receipt-only aggregators from G1 prime effect-level claims

B5.ranking: max min per-effect TPR, then lower FPR, then original chosen model; report both ranks and frozen B2 Wilson results
B5.selection_split: pooled eligible nonformal estimation splits only

B6.admissibility: all qualification effect LCB >= 0.90 and false-upgrade UCB <= 0.05; formal G1 prime remains pending until B7
B6.none_feasible: UNCERTIFIABLE; no fabricated seal or S2 candidate set
B6.threshold_estimation: same B0 Wilson rule replacing target 0.90 with grid target; qualification never added to estimation
B6.tie_break: highest qualification oracle decision agreement, then lowest false upgrades, then highest min effect LCB, then higher target, then original model

B7: Use only sealed selected candidate; adversarial lower bound and inherited-oracle upper bound, neutral assumption separately; disagreement units only from selected candidate; no cross-variant union
G1_prime: Each selected-variant formal per-effect TPR Wilson 95% LCB >= 0.90
Formal false-upgrade Wilson 95% UCB <= 0.05 and one-sided exact binomial p < 0.05 against fixed B3 baseline p=0.50
Threshold/model/operating-point selection process reads zero formal paths, demonstrated by isolated process read audit and seal
Phase-5 decision replay mismatch = 0 across 1680 rows
publication: Publish code/tests/diagnostic evidence to GitHub main and step8/实验报告; no Phase-6/7 final report; stop for human confirmation.
sample_size_precision: The requested 0.973 is a planning approximation; exact integer counts and the frozen Wilson formula govern certification, never rounded TPR.
sample_size_statement_requested: n=72~80 时认证 LCB>=0.90 需要经验 TPR >= 0.973

threshold_rule.no_feasible_threshold: UNCERTIFIABLE; record maximum attainable LCB; never silently pass
threshold_rule.per_effect: highest observed-score threshold with Wilson two-sided 95% TPR lower bound >= 0.90
threshold_rule.splits: all non-formal splits proven unused for model fitting, excluding qualification held-out
threshold_rule.under_35: UNCERTIFIABLE even if other criteria appear favorable
